CustomField.description: Durable failure surface for the SharePoint deal-folder callout — the HTTP status/body or exception message from the most recent failed attempt. Blank does not mean nothing was ever attempted; check SharePoint_Folder_Status__c for that.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by DealFolderService/DealFolderSweepBatch on a failed folder-create callout.
CustomField.label: SharePoint Folder Error
